codex_credit_exhausted.action: Use the Responses API path when OPENAI_API_KEY is available. Otherwise block publication and raise an independent watchdog failure.

openai_quota_exhausted.action: Resume from checkpoints after quota recovery. Never replace missing evidence with configured seed URLs.

model_token_budget_exhausted.action: Resume at the interrupted slot or category with smaller bounded inputs. Never truncate claim-to-source facts to force completion.

rate_limited.action: Retry with bounded exponential backoff and preserve completed task checkpoints.

execution_timeout.action: Preserve completed parts, retry only the interrupted unit, and use the deadline watchdog to decide whether publication must block.

authentication_unavailable.action: Use an already completed reviewed bundle only when every URL has explicit live evidence; otherwise block.

network_unavailable.action: Keep completed local checkpoints and retry transport. Do not claim public success.

github_unavailable.action: Keep the verified local issue and retry push/deployment up to three times; public success remains false.

dirty_worktree.action: Do not discard unrelated work. Report the blocking paths and require an intentional content-only commit.

partial_execution.action: Resume from the last durable stage checkpoint instead of restarting completed stages.

never_do: publish a stale prior issue as the current issue
mark configured URLs as observed without direct evidence
report success without the public root and dated URL
hide runtime exhaustion behind an IN_PROGRESS status
